# TLC run record of the TLA+ layer (generated by scripts/make_runs_md.py from the run logs)

Every row is read from TLC's own output in the log; the spec and configuration hashes are the ones the log
header recorded for the run. A row marked "cfg hash differs" means the configuration file in the folder no
longer matches the run (only comment lines were changed, see the README). Evidence, never proof.
